query: Free Edition, Agent Skills, Spark SDP and DABs, DQX and dbldatagen compatibility for a four-hour Databricks workshop

claims.text: Free Edition has one workspace and metastore per account and one active Lakeflow pipeline per pipeline type.
claims.excerpt: One workspace and one metastore per account. Lakeflow pipelines: One active pipeline per pipeline type.

claims.text: The current Apache Spark local SDP path uses the pipelines extra and pyspark.pipelines.
claims.excerpt: pip install pyspark[pipelines]. Apache Spark includes declarative pipelines beginning in Spark 4.1.

claims.text: Lakeflow pipeline environment versions 3 and 4 are supported and must be treated as version-sensitive.
claims.excerpt: Lakeflow pipelines support environment versions 3 and 4 on both serverless and classic compute.

claims.text: DQX supports Lakeflow pipelines and dbldatagen has a serverless-oriented release, but the exact Spark 4.2 tuple still requires a smoke test.
